title: 先進封裝共同設計
summary: 以 20 模組、520 項可保存進度的教學操作，串聯來料、薄化、切割、接合、扇出、RDL、TSV、HBM、散熱與 CPO 驗證；其中 40 項另有定量算例、模型邊界與診斷策略。
summaryEn: Twenty modules and 520 progress-preserving educational operations connect incoming inspection, thinning, dicing, bonding, fan-out, RDL, TSVs, HBM, cooling and CPO verification; 40 selected operations add quantitative examples, model boundaries and diagnostics.
scope: 公開原理與原創教學模型的分支流程；520 步涵蓋互斥或可選工法，不是每件產品都須依序執行的單一量產配方。新算例皆明示假設；原有步驟 ID 與進度對應保留。
scopeEn: A branching curriculum based on public principles and authored models. The 520 operations include alternative and optional routes, not one production recipe every product follows. New examples are hypothetical, and original step IDs remain stable.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「先進封裝共同設計」的「辨識封裝功能邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Identify package functions” in “Advanced Packaging Co-Design”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 教學高度堆疊：晶粒 100±5 µm、黏著層 20±3 µm、上蓋間隙 50±4 µm，名目 170 µm，線性最壞範圍 158–182 µm。若公差是獨立零均值標準差，RSS 為 7.07 µm；不能把圖面最大公差直接當標準差。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching stack: die 100±5 µm, adhesive 20±3 µm and lid gap 50±4 µm give nominal 170 µm and worst-case 158–182 µm. RSS is 7.07 µm only if terms are independent zero-mean standard deviations; drawing limits are not automatically standard deviations.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略

knowledge.textEn: Define reference planes, then inspect bow, tilt and local peaks; one center thickness does not prove clearance over the full envelope.
